main.description: How any tenant handled incoming records in a window, by collection and action. The same shape as server.getIngestMetrics. Admin only.

window.description: How far back to read. 1h and 24h come from the instance's memory; 7d and 30d from what it stored, as far back as it keeps.

enabled.description: Whether the instance is recording metrics at all.

retentionDays.description: On 7d and 30d: how many days the instance keeps, so a longer window covers only that.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The tenant id is not a UUID, or the window is not one this method takes.

errors.name: MetricsUnavailable
errors.description: The instance is not running, or its host cannot be reached.

errors.name: MetricsBusy
errors.description: Too many metrics reads are running for this instance or its host. Try again shortly.

errors.name: MetricsTimeout
errors.description: The instance's HappyView did not answer in time. Try again shortly.

errors.name: NotSupported
errors.description: The instance runs a HappyView too old to report its metrics. Upgrading it fixes this.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not HappyProto staff, or the provisioner does not treat them as staff.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The provisioner is unreachable, not configured, or answered with an error it does not explain to callers.
